passage.en: On my first Monday, our teacher took attendance in the bright classroom. She said the lesson would be short, but my assignment was already written in my notebook before recess. During the quiz I forgot one answer, and my grade was not perfect. After school, homework waited on my desk. Yet the next morning, my teacher smiled and said every small mistake is a new beginning. I felt brave again.
passage.zh: 第一个星期一，老师在明亮的教室里点名。她说这节课会很短，但课间休息前，作业已经写在了我的笔记本上。小测验时我忘了一个答案，成绩并不完美。放学后，作业还在书桌上等着我。可第二天早上，老师笑着说，每一个小错误都是新的开始。我又有了勇气。

passage.en: I studied hard for the exam, but one question still worried me. I wrote my answer carefully and hoped to pass. When the result came, my score was higher than I expected. My teacher did not just explain the correct choice; she gave another example on the board. I used to fear failing, but now I know a test is only a mirror, showing what to learn next.
passage.zh: 我为考试努力复习，可有一道题仍让我担心。我认真写下答案，希望能通过。成绩出来时，分数比我想象的还高。老师不只解释了正确答案，还在黑板上另举了一个例子。从前我怕考砸，如今我明白，考试只是一面镜子，告诉我下一步该学什么。

passage.en: For our history project, I went to the library to do research. I borrowed two books and used an old map as a reference. I wrote an outline first, then a short report with a summary at the end. Before I returned the books, I spent one more hour reviewing my notes. Finishing on time made me proud, and the quiet library felt like a friend.
passage.zh: 为了历史课题，我去图书馆做研究。我借了两本书，还用一张旧地图作参考。我先列了提纲，再写了一份短报告，最后附上总结。还书之前，我又花了一个小时复习笔记。按时完成让我很自豪，安静的图书馆像一位朋友。

passage.en: This semester, our campus feels full of energy. My schedule is busy: classes in the morning and club practice in the afternoon. We rehearse every Tuesday for a big event next month. Our coach says our team must work together to win the tournament. Practice is sometimes hard, but I love being part of something bigger than myself.
passage.zh: 这个学期，校园里充满活力。我的日程很满：上午上课，下午社团训练。每周二我们都要为下个月的大型活动排练。教练说，团队必须齐心协力才能赢得比赛。训练有时很苦，但我喜欢成为比自己更大的一件事的一部分。

passage.en: My routine begins with a quick breakfast at seven. I follow a simple schedule: after breakfast, I do a small chore like washing dishes. On weekends I run an errand for groceries and do the laundry. Mother uses a recipe with fresh ingredients to prepare our evening meal. Even a busy day feels calm when everything has its place.
passage.zh: 我的日常从七点一顿简单的早餐开始。我遵循着简单的安排：早饭后做点家务，比如洗碗。周末我会出门采购食品杂货，还要洗衣服。妈妈照着食谱，用新鲜食材准备晚饭。哪怕忙碌的日子，只要一切各归其位，心里也会平静。

passage.en: Yesterday I commuted to the city by train, my favorite vehicle for long trips. As a passenger, I checked the direction and chose the fastest route. From the window, the traffic on the roads below looked heavy. A signal problem near the bridge slowed us, but I had bought my ticket early and waited on the platform. Thanks to clear signs, I reached my destination on time, and with a smile.
passage.zh: 昨天我坐火车通勤去城里，这是长途出行我最喜欢的交通工具。作为乘客，我确认了方向，选好最快的路线。从车窗望下去，路上的车流看起来很拥挤。桥附近的信号故障让我们慢了下来，不过我早就买好了票，在站台上等候。多亏指示牌清楚，我准时到达了目的地，还带着笑容。

passage.en: As a careful customer, I set a budget before shopping. Last Saturday I wanted to buy a jacket. I compared the price in three shops and found one on sale with a discount. The quality was good, so I made the purchase. I kept the receipt in case I needed a refund. Smart shopping is not just about saving money; it is about knowing what you truly need.
passage.zh: 作为一个细心的顾客，我购物前会先定好预算。上周六我想买件夹克。我比较了三家店的价格，找到一件打折的。质量不错，我就买下了。我留着收据，以防需要退款。聪明消费不只是省钱，更是明白自己真正需要什么。

passage.en: I made an appointment at the clinic by phone. The receptionist checked what time was available and helped me confirm the reservation. I requested a morning slot because of my class. Two days later, the clinic called to notify me of a short delay. I could not wait, so I had to cancel the morning appointment and postpone the visit to next week. Good service, I learned, means clear and kind communication.
passage.zh: 我打电话预约了诊所。接待员查了空余时间，帮我确认了预约。因为要上课，我请求安排在上午。两天后，诊所打电话通知我稍有延迟。我不能等，只好取消了上午的预约，把就诊推迟到下周。我明白了，好的服务意味着清楚而友善的沟通。

passage.en: Our group project began with a long talk. We analyzed the data, arranged our tasks, and communicated by email. Before we completed the report, we compared our ideas and considered every detail. I described the results, and we discovered a small error we could identify and fix. Step by step, we improved our work, and our friendship too.
passage.zh: 我们的小组项目始于一次长谈。我们分析数据、安排任务，通过邮件沟通。完成报告前，我们比较了彼此的想法，考虑了每个细节。我描述了结果，我们发现并修正了一个小错误。一步一步，我们改进了作业，也加深了友谊。

passage.en: In science class we observed the plants and predicted how they would grow. We prepared the soil and provided enough water. To solve the problem of slow growth, we required more light. After a week we recognized a clear change. We summarized our notes and participated in a discussion. At last, we achieved a result that surprised everyone.
passage.zh: 科学课上，我们观察植物，预测它们会怎样生长。我们准备土壤，提供足够的水。为了解决生长缓慢的问题，我们需要更多光照。一周后，我们看到了明显的变化。我们总结笔记，参与讨论。最终，我们取得了让所有人都惊喜的结果。

passage.en: My report was due on Friday, and I nearly gave up. The basic facts were available in the library, but some questions were complex. I made an accurate outline, and constant effort made the work effective. Frequent practice was essential, and the improvement was obvious. My teacher gave me positive feedback. I learned that careful work is the most reliable resource, and that I am stronger than I think.
passage.zh: 我的报告星期五要交，我差点放弃。基本资料在图书馆能找到，但有些问题很复杂。我列了准确的提纲，持续的努力让工作有了成效。经常练习很重要，进步也显而易见。老师给了我积极的反馈。我懂得，认真是最可靠的资源，而我也比自己以为的更强。

passage.en: We visited an ancient temple built in a traditional style. Its carvings were original and showed diverse influences from many cultures. Our guide explained the immediate reason for each feature and the potential meaning behind it. In a global context, such sites are critical evidence of history. As the sun went down, the carvings looked even more beautiful. Look at the specific details, and you will see the natural beauty.
passage.zh: 我们参观了一座传统风格的古庙。它的雕刻独具匠心，展现出多种文化的交融。导游解释了每处细节的直接成因和背后可能的含义。在全球视野下，这样的遗址是历史的关键证据。夕阳西下时，雕刻显得更美。只要细看那些具体的细节，你就能看见自然的美。

passage.en: I currently live in a small town, but I frequently visit the city. I plan carefully before a trip and check the map clearly. The bus arrives approximately every ten minutes, and the driver constantly keeps to the schedule. I can directly reach the museum. Actually, my first trip took longer than I thought. Eventually, I learned to leave early, and now I completely enjoy the journey.
passage.zh: 我现在住在小镇，但常去城里。出行前我会仔细计划，把地图看清楚。公交车大约每十分钟一趟，司机也始终准时发车。我可以直接到达博物馆。其实，第一次出行花的时间比我想的长。后来我学会早点出门，如今我完全享受这段旅程。

passage.en: I typically get up at six, and generally have breakfast with my family. Originally, I thought the walk to school was boring, but now I see it differently. Occasionally I meet a neighbor, and we talk naturally. Particularly in winter, the morning is quiet. Previously I was always in a hurry; now I regularly leave with plenty of time. Yesterday, it suddenly began to snow, and I immediately ran to the window.
passage.zh: 我通常六点起床，一般和家人一起吃早餐。起初我觉得走路上学很无聊，现在看法不同了。偶尔遇到邻居，我们会自然地聊几句。尤其是冬天，早晨很安静。以前我总是匆忙，现在我会留出充足的时间从容出门。昨天突然下起雪来，我立刻跑到窗边。

passage.en: Many students fear writing; however, it becomes easier with practice. Therefore, I write a little every day. Moreover, reading good essays helps a lot. Although it takes time, the results are clear because words slowly become familiar. Unless you give up, you will improve. Meanwhile, keep a small notebook. In my class, we even exchange stories, and as friends read them, writing feels less difficult.
passage.zh: 许多学生害怕写作，然而练习会让它变容易。因此，我每天写一点。而且，读好文章也大有帮助。虽然要花时间，但效果很明显，因为词句慢慢变熟悉了。除非你放弃，否则一定会进步。与此同时，随身带个小本子。我们班甚至交换故事，当朋友们读它们时，写作就没那么难了。

passage.en: At first I was curious about the new club. I felt confident on the first day, but soon became anxious before the test. When I got the highest score, I was excited. My friend was frustrated because of his mistakes, yet he was determined to try again. Our teacher was impressed with our progress but skeptical of easy answers. Some students were puzzled, while others were enthusiastic about the next challenge.
passage.zh: 起初我对新社团很好奇。第一天我很自信，可考试前很快就焦虑起来。拿到最高分时，我兴奋极了。朋友因为出错而沮丧，却决心再试一次。老师对我们的进步印象很深，但对轻易得来的答案持保留态度。有些同学困惑，另一些则对下一个挑战充满热情。

passage.en: My ancestor came from a small village, and now our generation lives in a big city. As a citizen, I care about our community, our growing population, and the future of society. In my neighborhood, all the neighbors know each other. We keep a custom of sharing meals and a tradition of helping newcomers. Last year I worked as a volunteer to clean the park. Small actions shape a better world.
passage.zh: 我的祖先来自一个小村庄，如今我们这一代住在大城市。作为一名公民，我关心社区、不断增长的人口，以及社会的未来。在我们街区，所有邻居彼此都认识。我们保留着分享饭菜的习俗和帮助新人的传统。去年我自愿打扫公园。微小的行动，塑造着更好的世界。

passage.en: Everyone has the ability to learn, but the approach matters. One important aspect of study is finding your purpose. The main benefit is clear: you understand a concept better. Another key factor is time. If your situation changes, a flexible resource plan helps. People have a tendency to give up too early, so keep your goal in mind and try a different way.
passage.zh: 每个人都有学习的能力，但方法很重要。学习的一个重要方面是找到自己的目标。主要好处很清楚：你能更好地理解概念。另一个关键因素是时间。如果情况变化，灵活的资源计划会有帮助。人往往太早放弃，所以请把目标记在心里，换一种方式再试试。

passage.en: In the wetland near my school, every organism has a role. One species of bird returned to its habitat as the ecosystem woke up. A predator hunted its prey quietly, while smaller animals adapted to survive. Some birds migrate south in winter; frogs hibernate until spring. Over many years, species evolve to fit their environment. Standing there with my grandfather, I felt part of something ancient and gentle.
passage.zh: 在学校附近的湿地里，每个生物都有自己的角色。生态系统苏醒时，一种鸟回到了它的栖息地。捕食者悄悄追猎猎物，小动物则适应环境以求生存。有些鸟冬天南飞，青蛙冬眠到春天。许多年里，物种不断进化以适应环境。和爷爷站在那里，我感到自己属于某种古老而温柔的事物。

passage.en: When my little sister asked how plants eat, I tried to explain photosynthesis and pollination in simple words. Inside every living cell, genes carry information that children inherit from parents. Good immunity can fight a virus or harmful bacteria. A doctor may give a vaccine to prevent disease before any symptom appears. She listened with wide eyes, then asked if science could make her well forever. I smiled: science helps us understand the body, and love it more.
passage.zh: 妹妹问植物怎么吃东西时，我试着用简单的话解释光合作用和授粉。每个活细胞里，基因携带父母传给子女的信息。良好的免疫力可以抵抗病毒或有害细菌。医生会在症状出现之前接种疫苗，以预防疾病。她睁大眼睛听着，又问科学能不能让她永远不生病。我笑了：科学帮我们理解身体，也更懂得爱它。

passage.en: For our biology project, we chose a small garden. Good nutrition supports metabolism, which turns food into energy, and biodiversity gives every species a role. Some insects use camouflage to hide from a predator; a parasite lives on another organism. Domestic animals and garden plants both do well in fertile soil. We studied a specimen under a microscope to see how living things reproduce. That garden taught me to respect even the smallest life.
passage.zh: 生物课上，我们选了一个小花园做项目。良好的营养支持新陈代谢，把食物变成能量；生物多样性让每个物种各司其职。有些昆虫用保护色躲避天敌，寄生虫依附其他生物生存。家畜和花园里的植物，在肥沃的土壤里都长得好。我们在显微镜下观察标本，了解生物如何繁衍。那座花园让我学会尊重哪怕最微小的生命。

passage.en: On a school trip to the coast, our teacher showed us how the Earth changes. Rain causes erosion, carrying sediment down the river. A glacier had shaped the valley long ago. When a volcano erupted centuries before, ash covered the sky. An earthquake or a landslide can change a region in minutes. Each continent sits on tectonic plates that move slowly over centuries, leaving behind fossils and mineral deposits. I picked up a small stone and felt time in my hand.
passage.zh: 在海边的学校旅行中，老师让我们看到地球如何变化。雨水造成侵蚀，把泥沙带进河里。很久以前，冰川塑造了这条山谷。几个世纪前火山喷发时，灰烬遮住了天空。地震或山体滑坡能在几分钟内改变一个地区。每块大陆都位于缓慢移动的板块上，几个世纪下来留下化石和矿藏。我捡起一块小石头，感觉时间握在手里。

passage.en: My grandfather kept an old fossil on his shelf. It tells us about the climate of the past, he said. Today we must use more renewable energy and save water during a drought. Heavy rainfall can cause a flood, especially near the ocean. The tide changes twice a day, and latitude and altitude affect temperature. Understanding these patterns, he said, helps us prepare for change and live more gently on this planet.
passage.zh: 爷爷的书架上放着一块古老的化石。他说，它告诉我们过去的气候。今天我们必须更多地利用可再生能源，并在干旱时节约用水。强降雨可能引发洪水，尤其在海边。潮汐一天变化两次，纬度和海拔影响温度。他说，理解这些规律，能让我们为变化做好准备，也更温柔地生活在这个星球上。

passage.en: Last summer I slept in a tent with my brother. Earth is one planet that travels around the sun in an orbit, and gravity keeps everything in place. During an eclipse, the moon blocks the sunlight. With a telescope, we saw a distant galaxy, a bright comet, and a shooting meteor. Somewhere in the universe, a cloud of gas called a nebula forms new stars. We fell asleep feeling small, and wonderfully lucky.
passage.zh: 去年夏天我和哥哥睡在帐篷里。地球是一颗沿轨道绕太阳运行的行星，引力让一切各安其位。日食时，月亮挡住了阳光。用望远镜，我们看见遥远的星系、明亮的彗星和一颗划过的流星。宇宙某处，一片叫星云的气体正孕育新的星星。我们入睡时觉得自己很渺小，却幸运得不可思议。

passage.en: In the science room, Miss Li made light feel like magic. Light is a wave, and its wavelength determines its color. Some radiation, such as X-rays, has a high frequency and carries more energy. Kinetic energy depends on motion, while friction slows things down. In a vacuum, sound cannot travel. A conductor lets electricity pass; an insulator blocks it. A magnet pulled a pin across the table. I left the class seeing physics in every small thing.
passage.zh: 在科学教室，李老师让光像魔法一样。光是一种波，波长决定它的颜色。有些辐射，比如 X 射线，频率高、能量大。动能取决于运动，摩擦力让物体慢下来。真空中声音无法传播。导体让电流通过，绝缘体则阻挡。一块磁铁把别针吸过桌面。走出教室时，我在每件小事里都看见了物理。

passage.en: Grandma made tea while I did my homework. 'Water is a compound made of hydrogen and oxygen,' I read aloud. Each element consists of tiny atoms, and two or more atoms form a molecule. In a chemical reaction, an acid can dissolve metal. When water gets hot, it evaporates; when vapor cools, it condenses on the window. Over time, iron can corrode. Grandma said with a smile, 'Chemistry explains the quiet changes all around us, even in her teacup.'
passage.zh: 我在写作业时，奶奶泡了茶。我大声读道：“水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。”每种元素都由微小的原子构成，两个或更多原子形成分子。在化学反应中，酸能溶解金属。水受热会蒸发，蒸汽冷却会在窗上凝结。时间久了，铁会腐蚀。奶奶笑着说：“化学解释着我们周围悄悄发生的变化，就连我的茶杯里也有。”

passage.en: At the recycling center, a worker showed us around. An alloy is stronger than a single metal, and fiber is used to make cloth. A ceramic cup can hold hot water without melting. But some materials are toxic and cause air pollution. Smoke enters the atmosphere and worsens the greenhouse effect. We should recycle waste so it does not contaminate soil. 'Everyone wants a sustainable future,' she said, 'and it starts with the small choices we make at home.'
passage.zh: 在回收站，一位工作人员带我们参观。合金比单一金属更坚固，纤维用来做布料。陶瓷杯能装热水而不熔化。但有些材料有毒，会造成空气污染。烟雾进入大气，加剧温室效应。我们应当回收废弃物，以免污染土壤。她说：“每个人都想要可持续的未来，而这始于我们在家里做的小小选择。”

passage.en: In the museum, an old map took us back in time. A great civilization often begins near a river. In ancient times, one dynasty replaced another, and a powerful empire ruled a large area. Archaeology helps us learn about the past through a buried artifact or an old manuscript. A century later, a revolution can change everything. Migration brings new ideas and shapes history. I left wondering whose hands had once held that map.
passage.zh: 在博物馆里，一张旧地图把我们带回过去。伟大的文明常常起源于河边。古时候，一个王朝取代另一个，强大的帝国统治着辽阔的土地。考古学通过埋藏的文物和古老的手稿，帮助我们了解过去。一个世纪后，一场革命可以改变一切。迁徙带来新思想，塑造历史。离开时我在想，曾经是谁的手拿着这张地图。

passage.en: At the village festival, my uncle explained how society works. A strong economy depends on agriculture, industry, and commerce. When people work together, labor becomes more productive. Democracy gives citizens a voice in government. Philosophy asks big questions about life, while religion answers them in a different way. A traditional ritual brought everyone together that evening. In every society, culture shapes how people live, and how they dream.
passage.zh: 在乡村节庆上，叔叔向我们解释社会如何运转。强劲的经济依靠农业、工业和商业。人们一起工作时，劳动更有效率。民主让公民在政府中有发言权。哲学追问人生的大问题，宗教则以另一种方式作答。那天晚上，一场传统仪式把所有人都聚在一起。在每个社会里，文化塑造着人们如何生活，也如何梦想。

passage.en: In the small gallery, I met a painter. She had painted a portrait of an old man on a canvas, mixing bright pigment to show realistic light. In another room, an abstract sculpture stood near the window. The two artists' exhibition opened last week. The architecture of the building was beautiful, and visitors admired the building's aesthetic value. Art can express what words cannot, she said. I believed her.
passage.zh: 在小画廊里，我遇见一位画家。她在画布上画了一位老人，调出明亮的颜料来表现真实的光。另一个房间里，一尊抽象雕塑立在窗边。两位艺术家的展览上周开幕。建筑本身很美，参观者赞赏这座建筑的美学价值。她说，艺术能表达语言无法表达的东西。我相信她。

passage.en: At the concert, the composer sat beside me. She had written a melody with a gentle rhythm and added harmony for the strings. Each instrument had its own part in the performance. When it began, the audience listened quietly. Later, I read a poem from my literature book. Poetry uses beautiful words, just as music uses sound. Every genre has its own charm, and both can make a quiet evening feel full.
passage.zh: 音乐会上，作曲家坐在我旁边。她写了一段节奏轻柔的旋律，又为弦乐加了和声。每种乐器在演出中都有自己的声部。开始时，观众安静地聆听。后来，我从我的文学课本里读了一首诗。诗歌使用优美的词语，就像音乐使用声音。每种体裁都有自己的魅力，两者都能让安静的夜晚变得充实。

passage.en: At the market with Dad, I used math without noticing. To find the total, I estimated first and then calculated carefully. The ratio of apples to pears was two to three. If half the fruit in the basket was red, the percentage of red fruit was fifty. We found the average price by adding the numbers. Statistics help us read data, while probability tells us what may happen. In geometry class later, we measured the angles and the length of each side, and in science we estimated the quantity of water. Math felt like a puzzle coming together.
passage.zh: 和爸爸在市场上，我不知不觉用到了数学。为了算总数，我先估算，再仔细计算。苹果和梨的比例是二比三。如果篮子里一半的水果是红色的，红色水果的比例就是百分之五十。我们把数字相加求平均价格。统计帮我们读懂数据，概率告诉我们可能发生什么。后来在几何课上，我们测量了各个角和每条边的长度；在科学课上，我们估算了水的数量。数学像一块拼图，慢慢拼在了一起。

passage.en: My sister and I played with numbers at the kitchen table. We approximated the answer before calculating it exactly. We contrasted two graphs and studied the proportion of each color in a drawing. A sequence follows a pattern, and a variable can stand for any number. The sum comes from adding, the difference from subtracting. One number may be a multiple of another, and two fractions can be equivalent. The gap between them is an interval, and the gap between us closed with laughter.
passage.zh: 我和姐姐在餐桌边玩数字。我们先估算答案，再精确计算。我们对比两张图表，研究画中每种颜色的比例。数列遵循规律，变量可以代表任何数。和来自加法，差来自减法。一个数可能是另一个数的倍数，两个分数可能相等。它们之间的间隔叫做区间，而我和姐姐之间的距离，在笑声中消失了。

passage.en: For our science fair, we tested a simple idea. We started with a hypothesis and built a theory around it. To collect evidence, we conducted a survey and then an experiment. We observed the results carefully and demonstrated them in a chart. Our analysis had to indicate whether the idea was correct. In the end, we wrote a clear conclusion so others could understand the work. Curiosity, patiently tested, became knowledge.
passage.zh: 为了科学展，我们检验了一个简单的想法。我们先提出假设，再围绕它建立理论。为了收集证据，我们做了调查，然后做了实验。我们仔细观察结果，并用图表展示。分析必须说明这个想法是否正确。最后，我们写下清晰的结论，让别人也能读懂。好奇心经过耐心检验，变成了知识。

passage.en: In writing club, Ms. Wang taught us to be brave with words. She said we should suggest ideas and imply meaning without saying everything. First, define your key words, then classify your examples. A good writer can illustrate a point with a story and summarize the main idea. Before you evaluate the evidence, do not assume it is true. Try to establish a clear argument, even if others may contradict you. I wrote my first real essay that day.
passage.zh: 在写作社，王老师教我们要敢于用词。她说，应当提出想法，隐含意义，而不必把话说尽。先定义关键词，再给例子分类。好的作者能用故事说明观点，再总结主旨。在评估证据之前，不要假定它是真的。试着建立清晰的论证，哪怕别人可能反驳你。那天，我写下了人生第一篇真正的文章。

passage.en: The primary reason for the change was simple: we had a new teacher. A significant number of students joined the reading club, particularly in the second term. The task was relatively easy, and virtually everyone finished it. It was merely a small test, rather than a real exam. Hence, nobody felt stressed. Thus, the teacher was pleased. Whereas some classes were noisy, our class stayed quiet and learned more.
passage.zh: 变化的主要原因很简单：我们换了新老师。相当多的学生加入了阅读社，尤其是第二学期。任务相对容易，几乎每个人都完成了。那只是一个小测验，并不是真正的考试。因此，没有人感到压力。于是，老师很满意。有些班级很吵，而我们班保持安静，也学到了更多。

passage.en: My little brother is shy, but he notices everything. Human behavior is shaped by both instinct and learning. Our cognitive skills help us perceive the world and solve problems. A reward can motivate a student, and praise may reinforce good behavior. But money is not the only incentive. Personality matters: he thinks deeply, while I show quick intelligence. Watching him, I began to understand the mind and respect its quiet power.
passage.zh: 我弟弟很害羞，却什么都看在眼里。人的行为由本能和学习共同塑造。认知能力帮助我们感知世界、解决问题。奖励能激励学生，表扬能强化好行为。但金钱不是唯一的动力。性格很重要：他思考深刻，而我反应快。看着他，我开始理解人的心智，也尊重它安静的力量。

passage.en: Dad runs a small workshop. Its productivity rose when workers got better tools. If supply is low but demand is high, prices go up. When inflation grows, money buys less than before. A business must earn a profit to survive. A bonus can be a strong incentive to work harder. Many people invest in the market to grow their savings. Smart consumption, Dad says, depends on available resources and careful choices, and on knowing when enough is enough.
passage.zh: 爸爸开着一间小作坊。工人有了更好的工具，生产率就提高了。供不应求时，价格会上涨。通货膨胀时，同样的钱能买到的东西变少了。企业必须盈利才能生存。奖金是努力工作的强大动力。很多人投资市场，让积蓄增长。爸爸说，明智消费取决于可用资源和谨慎选择，也取决于懂得知足。

passage.en: My cousin builds robots. A smart device is made of many parts; inside it, a small mechanism controls each component. Engineers integrate these pieces and modify the design to make it efficient. Some factories use automated machines to work faster. Before mass production, they build a prototype and test it. Then they optimize the system step by step. To innovate, a team must be willing to try new ideas and learn from failure. Her first robot could only wave, but it waved at everyone.
passage.zh: 我表姐做机器人。智能设备由许多部件组成，内部一个小小的机械装置控制每个组件。工程师把这些部件整合起来，修改设计以提高效率。有些工厂用自动化机器加快速度。批量生产前，他们先做原型并测试，再逐步优化系统。要创新，团队必须愿意尝试新想法，并从失败中学习。她的第一个机器人只会挥手，但它向每个人都挥了手。

passage.en: On the last day of term, our teacher gave us one piece of advice. Good writing demonstrates clear thinking; consequently, readers understand your message. Furthermore, short sentences can make a strong point. Nevertheless, do not fear long ones when you need detail. Approximately eight out of ten students improve after practice. A significant change may take time, but the fundamental skill stays the same. Additional reading helps, and subsequently, an alternative method, writing every day, becomes clear. I wrote that down, and kept it.
passage.zh: 学期最后一天，老师给了我们一条建议。好文章体现清晰的思考，因此读者能明白你的意思。而且，短句能有力地表达观点。不过，需要细节时也不必怕长句。大约十分之八的学生在练习后进步。显著的改变可能需要时间，但基本功始终不变。额外阅读有帮助，随后另一种方法也变得清晰起来：每天写作。我把这些记了下来，并一直留着。
